parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: mlcc_logarithmic_aging_invalid
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: One elapsed decade at 100% loss leaves zero capacitance; the fit requires positive retained capacitance.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: mlcc_logarithmic_aging_recovery_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Three elapsed decades each lose 3% of the same 22 uF reference; no compounding: 22*(1-0.09)=20.02 uF.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: dielectric_absorption_recovery_invalid
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Short duration cannot be negative; finite-history protocol must reject this request.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: dielectric_absorption_recovery_recovery_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Ra*Ca=2 s. A 2*ln(2) charge reaches half of -12 V; the same short duration halves memory again to -3 V. Charge sharing across Cm=3Ca gives -0.75 V; recovery at tau*ln(2) gives -0.375 V.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: mlcc_bias_charge_energy_invalid
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Equal lower and upper endpoints have zero usable width and must fail.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: mlcc_bias_charge_energy_recovery_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: C(V)=12-1.5V uF. Trapezoid integrates C exactly over 1..5 V: Q=30 uC. Simpson integrates V*C exactly: W=82 uJ. Cq=Q/4 and Ce=2W/24.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: resistor_excess_noise_invalid
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Probe must stay inside characterized 2..200 Hz band.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: resistor_excess_noise_recovery_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Vishay 0 dB is 1 uV/V per decade. Two decades have 2*(3 uV)^2 variance; at 8 Hz, PSD is (3 uV)^2/(8 ln 10).

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: negative_vcr_divider_invalid
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: k=-0.001/V at 1000 V reaches zero fitted high-side resistance at supply; whole-interval positivity is strict.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: negative_vcr_divider_recovery_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Choose Vh=500 V: Rh=1 Mohm*(1-0.001*500)=500 kohm. Series current is 1 mA; bottom drop 100 V, supply 600 V. Ideal ratio 1/11 yields positive 5/6 fractional error.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: nonideal_r2r_ladder_invalid
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Three-bit code must be an integer, not an interpolated analogue code.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: nonideal_r2r_ladder_recovery_nondefault
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Independent rational nodal matrix after multiplying KCL by 1 kohm: rows [7/4,-1,0],[-1,5/2,-1],[0,-1,11/6], RHS [2,4,0]. Elimination gives physical nodes [232/71,264/71,144/71] V. Unit-current injection yields Rout=13500/11 ohm. Isolated subladder voltages are not physical loaded nodes.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: aging_one_hour_reference
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: At one hour the logarithmic age ratio is exactly one: zero decades, zero loss, unchanged reference capacitance.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: absorption_tiny_recovery_time
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Initial slope Va0/(Ra*Cm)=-0.5 V/s. At 1e-20 s higher terms are negligible; preserve -5e-21 V with no absolute floor.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: bias_adjacent_voltage_window
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Adjacent binary64 voltages near 3 V: local differential C=7.5 uF; charge=C*dV, energy=3*C*dV to relative error below 1e-15.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: bias_positive_fit_endpoint_regression
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Admitted positive fit endpoint must survive interpolation. At Vhi=Vfit, Chi=Cfit=1e-24 F exactly; the fixed endpoint-preserving catalog form retains it. Integral contributions below binary64 resolution do not alter rounded Q or W.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: noise_empty_band_finite_density
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: An empty band has zero integrated variance but nonzero spectral density; NI normalization does not change.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: vcr_tiny_negative_coefficient
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: First-order small-k ratio error is -k*Vs/(1+r)^2=600e-24/1.21, while voltages/resistance round to the ordinary divider. Do not subtract two almost equal gains.

parent_json_lines_scenarios.name: ladder_middle_bit_positive_uncorrected_error
parent_json_lines_scenarios.rationale: Independent unloaded nodal solution gives middle-bit weight 28/11 V, not ideal 2 V. Positive error +6/11 LSB is valid; switch mismatch need not yield negative error for each code.
